summary: Climb Bio filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce translational pharmacometric modeling and initial Phase 1 safety data for CLYM116, an anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody for IgA nephropathy. The filing provides preclinical and early clinical data, including projected human exposure, dose-dependent IgA suppression, and safety results from healthy volunteers and partner trials in Australia and China. No financial terms, transaction structure, or special-situation events are described. The filing is a routine operational update on clinical progress.
